_about: Source of truth for Thornreach's generated sound effects. build-sfx.py reads this, calls the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API once per (id, variant), writes MP3s to public/audio/sfx/<id>[-<n>].mp3, and records a content hash so unchanged prompts are skipped on re-runs. Each id matches a playSfx('<id>') name in client/audio.js, so a generated file transparently replaces that synth case; ids marked "new": true need a new trigger in the client (see notes). Tune the prompts/durations here before generating — this file is what spends credits.

sfx.prompt: A single dry, close-mic combat impact — a wooden staff or blunt weapon thudding into flesh and bone. Punchy, short, no music, no reverb tail, no voice.
A short, sharp non-verbal flinch of pain — a quick muffled grunt/gasp, androgynous, quiet and dry. No words, no music.

A night-creature dissipating — a low, hollow spectral groan that falls and fades into soft dark air. Warm low-mid body, rounded and muffled, soft at the edges. NO shrill highs, no sharp hiss, no piercing wail, no music, no words. Short and gentle.
The player's death knell — a single deep funeral bell toll over a low sinking drone that fades. Solemn, witchy, ominous. No music bed, no voice.
A single soft footstep on damp earth, moss and scattered leaves — muffled, close, understated. One step only, no music, no reverb.
sfx.note: NEW sound. Needs a trigger in the movement loop: play a round-robin of the variants on a step cadence while the player is moving (and not on every frame). I'll wire that when we integrate.

sfx.prompt: A witch casting a spell — a quick rising magical shimmer that charges up and releases with a soft sparkle tail. Airy, arcane, bright. No music, no words.
A dark summoning — the earth splitting with a low rumbling swell, then a dissonant minor chord of energy clawing upward. Ominous, ritual, heavy. No melody, no voice.
A malevolent hex being cast — a falling, clashing, dissonant magical zap with a bitter metallic edge. Short, nasty, arcane. No music.
A protective ward rising — a warm magical hum that swells into a steady shielding tone. Reassuring, resonant, brief. No melody, no voice.
An empowering buff — a low growling energy swell rising in power, like strength surging into the body. Dark, potent, short. No music.
A gentle healing spell — a soft rising chime shimmer, warm and restorative, like light knitting a wound closed. Pretty, airy. No words.
A hidden thing revealed — a whispery high glimmer, airy sparkle rising, a secret surfacing. Delicate, magical, short. No music, no voice.
A triumphant level-up flourish — a bright ascending magical arpeggio resolving to a shining top note, with a soft sparkle. Rewarding, uplifting, short. No full music track.

Picking up loot — a soft handful of coins clinking and shifting against each other as they settle, gentle and muffled, warm metallic. No bright chime or jingle, close and quiet. Short. No music, no voice.
Gathering a herb from the ground — a soft leafy rustle and a light pluck as the plant comes free. Natural, muffled, short. No music.
Drinking a potion — a quick series of liquid glugs and a soft swallow. Close, wet, short. No music, no words.
An action-denied cue — a low, soft, dissonant two-tone 'no' buzz. Muted, brief, not harsh. No music.
A light jump — a soft cloth-and-leather whoomph of a body springing up, understated, close. No music, no voice.
Stepping through an arcane portal — a swelling magical whoosh with an airy shimmer as reality folds past you. Mystical, brief. No music, no words.
A heavy wooden tavern door — an old iron latch and a low creak as it swings open and thuds shut. Close, wooden, no music.
A weapon swung hard through the air — a quick low whoosh, no impact, no clang. Dry and close. No music.
A bladed weapon slashing into a body — a sharp wet edged cut, quick and visceral. Close-mic, no reverb, no music, no voice.
A heavy blunt impact — a staff or mace thudding dully into flesh and bone. Weighty, short, dry. No music, no voice.
A bestial claw rending flesh — a feral tearing swipe with a low snarl edge, wet and savage. Short, close. No music.
A lone werewolf howl rising into the night — feral, mournful, swelling then fading. Wild and lonely. No music, no words.

Life force being siphoned out of a victim — a wet mid-range sucking, drawing, draining pull, like warm vitality pulled through the air toward the caster. Gurgling, visceral, organic, centered in the mids. No shrill highs, no deep sub rumble, no music, no voice. Short.
sfx.note: NEW sound. Wired in sfxForAbility: all leech-effect abilities (Leech Hex, Soul Siphon, Life Siphon) route here, falling back to 'curse' if the file isn't loaded.

sfx.prompt: A blacksmith forging gear — a hammer ringing against hot metal on an anvil, a bright metallic clang with a short ring-out and a faint ember hiss. Satisfying, warm, close. No music, no voice. Short.
sfx.note: NEW sound. Plays on craft_result and workshop_craft_result (gear/item crafts).

sfx.prompt: A witch's cauldron finishing a potion — thick liquid bubbling and glooping, then a soft glass cork pop as it's bottled. Wet, magical, cozy, mid-range. No music, no voice. Short.
sfx.note: NEW sound. Plays on witch_craft_result (Witch Hazel's cauldron brews).

sfx.prompt: Slipping through a hagstone into the otherworld — a cold rushing whoosh through a hole in ancient stone, a veil parting with an eerie airy shimmer over a low resonant hum, as if passing between worlds. Mystical, hushed, witchy. No music, no voice. Short.
sfx.note: NEW sound. Plays on moot_entered / moot_exited (passing through the coven Hagstone either way).

sfx.prompt: A quest-complete flourish — a short triumphant magical chime that rises and resolves warmly, bells and shimmer. Rewarding, distinct from a level-up. No full music track.

Accepting a quest — a soft parchment scroll unfurling with a gentle low chime of resolve, a task begun. Understated, warm, brief. Clearly lighter than a quest-complete fanfare. No music bed, no voice.
sfx.note: NEW sound. Plays on quest_started (the server's accept confirmation).

sfx.prompt: Equipping gear — a quick leather-and-metal shuffle and a soft buckle cinch as a weapon or armor piece is donned. Close, dry, understated. No music, no voice. Short.
sfx.note: NEW sound. Plays on inventory_equip and inventory_unequip (client send).
